company.shortDescription: Stilt offers financial services for immigrants, visa holders, and the underserved.
company.description: Stilt offers financial services for immigrants, visa holders, and the underserved. Stilt uses proprietary and public data sources to predict the creditworthiness of immigrants with limited or zero credit history. The company's lending platform offers short term loans to expatriates and non-citizens with limited credit history at lower interest rates, enabling them to access capital and receive credit.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $14,000,000, or 4.13% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,633,131 to $263,311,778, a 100x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
